properties.description: `gap_id` keys an AGGREGATE gap — one per project, whose affected set is the population its rule ranges over — on the rule alone, so its id is stable while the design grows and an acknowledgement of it carries instead of being re-asked on every addition. Every other gap keeps hashing its affected nodes, because there a changed subject genuinely deserves a fresh judgement. The discriminator is an explicit exhaustive `GapSource::is_aggregate()`, so a new aggregate detector must decide rather than inherit. Paired with the `retired` reporting `reviewed_gaps` already had: a stable id is only safe because a review whose rule stops firing is still shown, rather than silently kept.
properties.name: A gap about the whole population is keyed on its rule, so a standing judgement carries
